purpose: Strict JSON contract for AI/PDF-to-KiCad visual project generation.

project_object.name: slug_safe_project_name
project_object.title: human readable circuit title
analysis: SPICE/KiCad simulator directives as text, e.g. .op, .tran 1u 5m, .dc V1 0 10 0.1

component_object.id: Unique reference like R1, U1, C1, V1, G1
component_object.at: optional [x,y] in mm; omitted means auto-place
component_object.pins: map pin numbers to net names, e.g. {"1":"VIN","2":"GND"}

net_rules: Use meaningful net names: VIN, CLK, RESET, Q0, LOAD_CLK, etc.
Every useful electrical pin must map to a net.
Do not generate disconnected component-zoo sheets for functional PDF circuits.
Every generated project must save input.json beside the KiCad output.
kicad_rules: The user opens the .kicad_pro file only; KiCad still requires a .kicad_sch beside it.
Every wire object must have exactly two xy points.
Multiline directives must be escaped as \n inside the S-expression string.
Unsupported exact stock symbols may use project-local Progen generic symbols until source mining promotes exact KiCad stock symbols.
